summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _FileReader and _ReaderContext helpers, module-level open and wrap_file with overloads, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods), tests/test_progress.py (21 new tests before the script-entry block), docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections), CHANGELOG.md (one Added bullet linking PR 1759). Nothing was committed and no tests, linters, or type checkers were run, so all verification is still outstanding. Recommended next step: run pytest tests/test_progress.py and mypy rich/progress.py. Judgment calls: the context wrapper enters and exits the stream returned by Progress.open (a TextIOWrapper for text mode); a failed stream enter stops the display before re-raising; the module-level open implementation types mode as Any so it can call the overloaded Progress.open without an unlisted suppression; the columns omit the percentage column, per the spec's list; Progress.open creates the task before opening the file, per the spec's step order.
